normal_ui: Rich and prompt_toolkit; no new application dependency

session_navigation.full_create_rename_list_switch_chooser_a: Passed before dialog repair on unchanged session/UI components; retained as historical evidence

regression.command: python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests -q -p test_terminal_*.py

failed_attempts_preserved: Initial native dialogs hid the supplied question/scope outside the active alternate buffer and clipped the long skip label; actual product FAIL retained, then repaired and rechecked at both sizes.
Early parent glue tests had incorrect stdout-patch ordering and a narrow wrapping assertion; corrected without weakening product behavior.

Private QA repaired incremental ANSI observation, alternate-buffer/full-cell rendering, wrapped punctuation, key:value metrics parsing, path type comparison and derivative crop naming. Original failures and frames remain immutable; these were not extra winning model retries.

production_ownership.sessions_worker: Session/Turn dataclasses, SQLite catalogue and focused persistence tests
production_ownership.terminal_worker: Initial prompt/input/commands/status/logging module and focused tests
production_ownership.coordinator: Engine integration, source/authority resets, native dialog repair, status/startup follow-up after the UI worker's transport failure, module-syntax repair and documentation
production_ownership.independent_qa: Read-only real public ConPTY journeys, native dialogs, artifact/state/log audits and inspected temporal/full/detail frames

harrtest.formal_team_provenance: UNVERIFIED: Codex-only parent-thread adapter and stale initial UI-owner handoff after its failed repair turn

limitations: One accepted short TUI request is not a broad stochastic reliability benchmark.
Original complete Three.js game live acceptance is not claimed.
General evidence-licensed decomposition is a proposed research contribution, not implemented or evaluated by these product checks.
Four historical legacy-scheduler skips remain; five opt-in contributor browser cases were actually executed.
Raw host details, transcripts, SQLite data, screenshots with local paths and complete private logs are intentionally not newly published.
